readme: Hand-maintained standing ratification backlog. Anthony maintains this file by hand; the boot-pack assembler only READS it and PROJECTS its items into the unified decision queue (section 3). The queue ROUTES attention -- it never absorbs, performs, or clears ratification. Merge is Anthony's. Replace the placeholder below with real standing items as they arise, and delete items once ratified. Each item: {id, summary, kind (ratification|merge|ruling), waiting_since (ISO date), source}.

items.summary: PLACEHOLDER -- replace with a real standing ratification item (e.g. a parked cross-repo ratification awaiting Anthony's sign-off). This seed exists so the assembler has a valid feed shape to project.
